idea-plugin.name: MoLLM
idea-plugin.description: MoLLM chat, coding agent and LiteLLM usage dashboard. Read and search workspace files, review edits in a diff, approve commands and run tests with streaming tool calling. Multiple OpenAI-compatible gateways, model metadata and secure API key storage. Dedicated settings page and clipboard screenshot attachments for vision models in Chat and Agent. Adapted from MoLLM VS Code 0.3.11 (MIT, yhho).
